desc:
Welcome to the night shift at Bikini Bottom. You’ve just started your new job at Krusty Krab. The lights are warm, the music plays softly. Everything feels perfectly normal  maybe even a little boring. It’s just another quiet night among burgers and memories... or so you think. What could possibly go wrong?
